title: Great candle, but a complete rip off @ this price!
text: Great candle, but a complete rip off @ this price!. I really like these candles - especially Lavender & Cedarwood and Vanilla & Cedarwood - but this price is a complete rip off!  I got TWO of the 9 oz candles for $12 at Walgreens and Amazon wants $15 EACH???  Pop into your local Walgreens and save $18!
